scope_comparison: Theorem 1.3 equations 1.7–1.8 proves a time-integral and super-t-log-t limsup growth statement, not one fixed torus solution with sustained double-exponential growth for all times. Finite-duration constructions with data depending on duration and boundary-assisted results do not meet the target.
